nodes.label: ADR-005 Immutable submission revision copies
nodes.summary: Accepted review-workflow decision dated 2026-08-24: never overwrite submitted proposals; create linked draft revision copies with shared primary ticket.
nodes.rationale: Changing submitted data would break correspondence to historical Word/PDF and destroy review evidence.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Immutable linked revision family
nodes.summary: needs_revision records instruction and creates draft copy; root_proposal_id, revision_of_id, revision_number and revision_label preserve lineage; ticket stays shared.
nodes.rationale: Keep submitted data, attachments, documents and review history traceable.

nodes.label: Single active draft revision resume
nodes.summary: Primary ticket plus phone opens the one active draft revision, otherwise primary/latest state; only one draft allowed per family.
nodes.rationale: Shared ticket must resume unambiguously even after revisions exist.

edges.evidence: Explicit same ticket_number/revision_number family data contract
